description.value: Saffron is a family-owned East Indian restaurant on Cowrie Street in Sechelt, serving a broad menu of curries, pizza, pasta, ribs, and burgers. The kitchen grinds its own spices in-house, and most Indian mains are prepared wheat- and egg-free (excluding naan). It operates as a dine-in and takeout establishment, making it a practical meal stop for cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is an active, family-owned Indian restaurant at #59-5755 Cowrie St., Sechelt, BC with phone 604-740-0660, offering dine-in and takeout. Multiple menu items are labeled GF, and the site states Indian dishes are served wheat- and egg-free. No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM had no address or phone; both sourced from website (#59-5755 Cowrie St. Sechelt, BC V0N 3A0; 604-740-0660).
OSM opening_hours (We-Su 11:30-21:00) differ from website (Wed-Sun 11:00 am – 9:00 pm) — 30-minute earlier open time discrepancy.
Community field is 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Sechelt is on the BC Sunshine Coast (mainland), not Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, family-owned restaurant in Sechelt with dine-in and takeout, confirmed GF and vegetarian options, and a current website — a useful meal stop for Sunshine Coast cyclists.
